description: Add a bounded, visible retaliation state to the canonical thief and route authored provocations, ambushes, avoidance, sabotage, selective theft, and appeasement through existing thief behavior.

replacements.new:
<GLOBAL THIEF-HERE <>>

<ROUTINE THIEF-PROVOKE ()
	<COND (<NOT <G? <GETP ,THIEF ,P?VALUE> 0>>
	       <PUTP ,THIEF ,P?VALUE 1>
	       <TELL
"The thief's easy grin disappears. He studies you for one quiet second,
then nods as though adding your name to a private list. This has become
personal." CR>)>
	<RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE THIEF-ARMED-DETERRENT? ()
	<COND (<OR <IN? ,SWORD ,WINNER>
	           <IN? ,KNIFE ,WINNER>
	           <IN? ,RUSTY-KNIFE ,WINNER>>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (T <RFALSE>)>>

<ROUTINE THIEF-RETALIATION-TARGET ()
	<COND (<IN? ,WRENCH ,WINNER> ,WRENCH)
	      (<IN? ,SCREWDRIVER ,WINNER> ,SCREWDRIVER)
	      (<IN? ,KEYS ,WINNER> ,KEYS)
	      (<IN? ,MATCH ,WINNER> ,MATCH)
	      (<IN? ,SHOVEL ,WINNER> ,SHOVEL)
	      (T <RFALSE>)>>

<ROUTINE THIEF-RETALIATION-STRIKE ("AUX" X)
	<COND (<OR ,DEAD <NOT <G? <GETP ,THIEF ,P?VALUE> 0>>> <RFALSE>)
	      (<THIEF-ARMED-DETERRENT?>
	       <TELL
"A shadow starts to detach itself from the passage, notices the weapon in
your hand, and thinks better of the arrangement. You catch only the thief's
retreating footfall. The grudge, apparently, survives the tactical decision." CR>
	       <FSET ,THIEF ,INVISIBLE>
	       <SETG THIEF-HERE <>>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <IN? ,SANDWICH-BAG ,WINNER>
	            <FIRST? ,SANDWICH-BAG>>
	       <TELL
"The thief comes out of nowhere, hooks the brown sack open, and turns it
upside down before you can stop him. Its contents scatter across the floor.
He steps back into view with a small, vindictive bow. Nothing is destroyed;
he simply made sure you have to put your own affairs back in order." CR>
	       <MOVE-ALL ,SANDWICH-BAG ,HERE>
	       <FCLEAR ,THIEF ,INVISIBLE>
	       <SETG THIEF-HERE T>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<SET X <THIEF-RETALIATION-TARGET>>
	       <MOVE .X ,THIEF>
	       <FSET .X ,TOUCHBIT>
	       <FSET .X ,INVISIBLE>
	       <FCLEAR ,THIEF ,INVISIBLE>
	       <SETG THIEF-HERE T>
	       <TELL
"A gloved hand snaps in, takes the " D .X " with insulting precision, and
vanishes into the large bag. The thief then steps where you can see him.
This time the theft is plainly about inconvenience, not resale value." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (T <RFALSE>)>>
